title: Low Observability
description: Low Observability as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are signature requirements applicable to the installation identified?
Are external features that could affect signature identified?
Thermal (heat signature): are heat sources visible from outside the aircraft identified?
Thermal (heat signature): are external hot surfaces and exhaust-visible heat sources identified?
Are gaps, steps and fastener patterns on external surfaces controlled to the signature requirements?
Are signature treatments selected and compatible with other finishes?
Are signature requirements for the installation met?
Are signature treatments and external surface tolerances shown on the released definitions?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
